REPORT.TITLE: Platform Report
REPORT.JOURNEY_DESC: Monitor trainee progress throughout every stage of the program using key operational performance indicators and CV building blocks.
REPORT.PHASE_01_DESC: Provides an overview of trainee registrations, account activation, and initial assessments.
REPORT.PHASE_04_DESC: Presents assessment outcomes and trainee readiness.
REPORT.PHASE_05_DESC: Monitors proposal generation, CV compilation, and candidate profile optimization.
REPORT.HERO_DESC: This report provides a comprehensive overview of the Moga Edu Platform, presenting key performance indicators and candidate CV building blocks across all stages to help administrators monitor progress.
REPORT.PHASE_02_DESC: This stage presents screening results, admission rates, and key performance indicators for the selection process.
REPORT.PHASE_03_DESC: This stage highlights trainee progress throughout the learning paths and their engagement with the training content.
REPORT.CLOSING_DESC: This report provides a comprehensive view of the Moga Edu Platform, enabling administrators to monitor key performance indicators, track candidate CV building progress, and support informed decision-making.
REPORT.ANALYTICS_DESC: Visual analytics and percentage breakdowns showcasing trainee progression, course retention, assessment pass rates, and candidate CV readiness across all program stages.
REPORT.CHART_SUBTITLE: Average efficiency and success percentage per stage
REPORT.PHASE_01_KBI_1_DESC: Maps initial technical background and strengths to populate the core skills section of the candidate CV.
REPORT.PHASE_01_KBI_2_DESC: Generates a professional summary and tailored career objectives based on initial assessment data.
REPORT.PHASE_02_KBI_1_DESC: Certifies English proficiency (B1+) and adds verified language badges to candidate resume credentials.
REPORT.PHASE_02_KBI_2_DESC: Validates fundamental technical competencies to establish initial credibility on candidate profiles.
REPORT.PHASE_03_KBI_1_DESC: Automatically imports completed course certificates and skill micro-credentials directly into the CV.
REPORT.PHASE_03_KBI_2_DESC: Transforms completed practical tasks into structured project entries for the CV experience section.
REPORT.PHASE_04_KBI_1_DESC: Certifies candidate overall technical and practical readiness with an official platform score.
REPORT.PHASE_04_KBI_2_DESC: Attaches verified capstone accomplishments and practical problem-solving metrics to the portfolio.
REPORT.PHASE_05_KBI_1_DESC: Compiles verified skills, certificates, and projects into a professional download-ready CV.
REPORT.PHASE_05_KBI_2_DESC: Generates customized proposal templates and optimized profiles for Upwork, Freelancer, and Fiverr.
